data.name: Kaiqad
data.gender_notes: Kaiqad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Drives Away Evil
data.long_meaning: The One Who Drives Away, Scatters, and Wards Off Evil. The name Kaiqad carries the meaning “The One Who Drives Away Evil” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kaiqad usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who drives away evil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that instills a sense of protection and strength against negative energies and influences.
data.etymology: Kaiqad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Drives Away Evil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaiqad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: كايقاد
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من قاد ومعناه قائد ومقدم في الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: كايقاد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه قائد ومقدم في الخير، مشتق من الفعل قاد الذي يعني الإرشاد والتوجيه. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القيم والفلاح، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياقات مختلفة تتعلق بالإرشاد والقيادة.

in_urdu.name: کائقاد
in_urdu.meaning: قائد ومقدم في الخير، ایک اچھا رہنما
in_urdu.long_meaning: کائقاد ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قائد ومقدم في الخير۔ یہ نام قاد فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی کرنا اور اچھی طرف لانا۔ یہ نام ان خوبصورت معانی کو اپنے ساتھ رکھتا ہے جو اسلامی تقالید اور اچھے کردار کی تعمیر میں اہم کردار ادا کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: कायक़ाद
in_hindi.meaning: एक अच्छा मार्गदर्शक, नेता और अच्छा परिचायक
in_hindi.long_meaning: कायक़ाद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है एक अच्छा मार्गदर्शक और नेता। यह नाम 'क़ादा' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन करना और अच्छे रास्ते पर लाना। यह नाम उन सुंदर अर्थों को अपने साथ रखता है जो इस्लामी परंपराओं और अच्छे चरित्र निर्माण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: کایقاد
in_pashto.long_meaning: کایقاد د عربي نوم څخه دی چې معنی یې د خیر قائد او مخکښ دی. دا نوم د قاد فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې لارښودنه او د ښو لارې ښودل دي. دا نوم داسې ښکلي معنا لري چې په اسلامي دودونو او د ښو ځانګړتیاو په جوړولو کې مهم رول لوبوي.

in_english.name: Kaiqad
in_english.meaning: A good leader, guide, and forerunner in goodness
in_english.long_meaning: Kaiqad is an Arabic name that means a good leader, guide, and forerunner in goodness. It is derived from the verb 'qāda', which means to guide, lead, and show the right way. This name carries beautiful meanings related to guidance, leadership, and righteousness, which are highly valued in Islamic tradition. The name Kaiqad reflects positive personality traits such as leadership, guidance, and a strong moral compass.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaiqad carries a rich cultural heritage in the Islamic world. The name signifies someone who protects, shields, and guards against evil. This is an important role in many Islamic societies where community and mutual protection are highly valued. People named Kaiqad are often seen as having protective powers, and may be looked upon as a source of strength and security for their families and communities. Additionally, the name Kaiqad is linked to warrior tribes in some Muslim communities, highlighting the idea of defense and protection through physical action.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kaiqad holds profound spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It is a reminder of the belief that the ultimate protection and security comes from God. The name evokes the concept of faith and otherworldly protection. In the Islamic tradition, individuals are encouraged to turn to God for safety and guidance, rather than relying solely on material possessions or worldly strength. The name Kaiqad is a constant reminder of the importance of seeking divine protection and relying on the support of the divine. It is a name that instills a sense of peace and confidence in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The One Who Drives Away Evil" symbolizes The One Who Drives Away, Scatters, and Wards Off Evil. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kaiqad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the one who drives away evil.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun's 'Al-'Ibar', Volume 1, Chapter 14, The Berbers of the Maghrib The name Kaiqad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun describes Kaiqad as the founder of the Hafsid Dynasty in the Maghreb in around 1236 CE. He was a Berber chief from the Banu Rasid tribe and established the new capital at Tunis.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam's 'The History of the Berbers', Chapter 18, On the Conquest of Tunisia by the Almohads
historical_references.context: Ibn Abd al-Hakam mentions Kaiqad as the Berber chief who had ruled Tunis and the surrounding region before the Almohad conquest in the late 12th century. He was a vassal of the Almohad caliph, but rebelled against him and was eventually defeated and killed.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kaiqad' is of Islamic origin and is believed to have been the name of the 12th caliph of the Umayyad Caliphate, Al-Mansur Al-Kaiqad. He ruled from 754 to 775 AD and is known for his military conquests and the construction of the Great Mosque of Kufa. Today, this name is often discussed on platforms like Reddit, Quora, and Academia.edu in the context of Islamic history, Muslim names, and ancient civilizations. Discussions cover topics like his rule, military campaigns, architectural achievements, and the impact of his reign on Islamic civilization.
